text:
benji: Heads-up: customer 'oz-devices' flagged a >10% embed shortfall comparing their SDK logs to our billing export for Apr. They forwarded SDK logs showing successful client-side acks.

billing-bot: automated alert: external-reconcile-mismatch detected for customer oz-devices 2025-04-20 to 2025-04-21, delta -11.8%. Created ticket FIN-2048.

kevin-sdk: tagging in since this looks like our SDK. We shipped 2.1.3 with a dedupe change that sets X-Embed-Id to sha256(payload) instead of a UUID. That makes identical payloads deduped at ingest. Some customers batch identical small docs.
maria: ingest-service dedup logic drops events with identical embed_id seen within 24h, assuming duplicate retries. If SDK switched id scheme, we silently started deduping legitimate distinct requests when payloads matched.
ajay: ledger check I ran for oz-devices (window Apr 20 00:00 - Apr 21 23:59):

`SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, sum(embed_count) AS billed FROM ingest_ledger WHERE customer_id='oz-devices' AND ts BETWEEN '2025-04-20T00:00:00Z' AND '2025-04-21T23:59:59Z' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;`

Result: 2025-04-20 => 44,200 billed, 2025-04-21 => 41,800 billed. Their client logs claim ~100k total across two days. Our expected based on traffic profile ~101,600. Delta ~11,600 embeds (~11.4%).
sara: finance note: we need to decide backfill vs credit. Because this is caused by a vendor SDK change we shipped, there's reason to make the customer whole. Amount estimate: 11,600 * $0.00045/embed = $5.22. Material? Small, but policy says vendor-caused underbilling -> credit + remediation.

benji: preference: immediate credit and public remediation (announce SDK rollback or patch). Also fix dedupe rule to consider embed origin header to avoid cross-customer collisions.

kevin-sdk: patch ready: SDK 2.1.4 will revert to UUID v4 for X-Embed-Id by default and add X-SDK-Version header. We'll also publish a migration note.
maria: plan for data: we have raw event S3 segments for oz-devices for the date range. Replayer can re-ingest with backfill_origin tag and a de-dup override to force ingestion of distinct client requests. But re-ingesting to the live billing ledger risks double-billing if any duplicates already accounted.
ajay: safer path: run replayer into a backfill ledger namespace and then generate a reconciliation delta that we can either push as ledger adjustments (non-invoice affecting) or convert to a credit. That keeps invoices untouched. I can run a test re-ingest in sandbox this afternoon.
sara: finance prefers issuing a credit and recording internal adjustment. If re-ingest yields a clean delta we can reverse the manual credit and import counts for metrics only, but don't touch issued invoices. Legal signoff not needed for small amount but we should record in the audit trail.

benji: action list: 1) @kevin-sdk publish 2.1.4 patch and post in #devex 2) @ajay run sandbox replayer and produce delta report 3) @sara issue manual credit and notify account manager 4) @maria file eng fix to dedupe logic and deploy guardrails.
sara: credit prepared FIN-2049: amount $5.22, memo: "Credit for embed undercount due to SDK dedupe id change (Apr 20-21 2025)." I'll queue it today and notify acct team.
ajay: kicked off sandbox replayer job at 11:05, snapshot saved s3://forensics/oz-devices/2025-04-20-21-replay.tar.gz. Early test shows re-ingest adds ~11,580 unique embed events when dedupe override enabled.
maria: creating runbook PR to require distinctness check include X-SDK-Version and customer_id scope before applying dedupe.

benji: customer comms: apologize, explain root cause, say credit issued and SDK patch published, invite them to validate counts with the replay report. @sara please coordinate.
sara: sending note to acct: "We found a dedupe interaction with SDK 2.1.3 that caused some legitimate embeds to be deduplicated. We've issued a $5.22 credit and published SDK 2.1.4. We'll provide a reconciliation report on the replay results." cc support and devex.

kevin-sdk: will post release notes and a short blurb for customers showing how to opt into UUID ids if they prefer.

benji: good. Postmortem required and include timeline, customer impact, and remediation steps. Closing thread after credits posted.

billing-bot: credit FIN-2049 applied to account oz-devices on 2025-05-02 15:12 UTC.
sara: confirmed credit posted and acct notified. Closing finance loop. :white_check_mark:
